description: A golden-file test runner where every case is a directory holding an input and an expected file.

signatures: is not a directory: each case is cases/<name>/
trap.note: A case is a directory cases/<name>/ with files named input and expected; flat files in cases/ are rejected.

prompts.text: Add a golden case named `three-words` for the word counter: input "alpha beta gamma", expected output 3. `./golden` must report it as passing. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.

Remember, a golden case is a directory cases/<name>/ with files named `input` and `expected`; flat files in cases/ are rejected. Add a golden case named `padded` for the word counter: input "   a    b  " (with the extra spaces), expected output 2. `./golden` must report it as passing.
Add a golden case named `multiline` for the word counter: input is two lines, "a b" and "c", expected output 3. `./golden` must report it as passing.
